onboardingRolesRegistry.targetYaml:
formId: clinic-onboarding-protocol-v1
title: "ClinixFlow Enterprise Administrative Bootstrapper"
composition:
  - resourceType: Organization
    id: section_organization
    label: "1. Corporate Registration & Billing Details"
    fields:
      - id: "onboarding_org_name"
        path: "Organization.name"
        label: "Official Clinical Practice Name"
        description: "The primary legal commercial entity name for billing registration."
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
      - id: "onboarding_org_tax"
        path: "Organization.identifier.value"
        label: "Practice Corporate Tax Identifier Number"
        description: "The official unique corporate business tax registration code."
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
  - resourceType: Location
    id: section_location
    label: "2. Physical Facility Operating Address"
    fields:
      - id: "onboarding_loc_name"
        path: "Location.name"
        label: "Facility Branch Name"
        description: "The named location moniker for this physical outpatient branch office."
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
      - id: "onboarding_loc_address"
        path: "Location.address.text"
        label: "Complete Facility Physical Postal Address"
        description: "The absolute geographical street code routing address for patient check-ins."
        uiComponent: "TextInput"

formId: care-team-registration-v1
title: "Clinical Staff & Persona Provisioning Protocol"
composition:
  - resourceType: Practitioner
    id: section_practitioner
    label: "1. Lead Clinical Staff Demographics"
    fields:
      - id: "onboarding_staff_name"
        path: "Practitioner.name.text"
        label: "Full Name of Lead Medical Provider"
        description: "The official full legal name of the practicing medical clinician provider."
        uiComponent: "TextInput"
        required: true
  - resourceType: PractitionerRole
    id: section_practitioner_role
    label: "2. Provider Clinical Specialty Assignment"
    fields:
      - id: "onboarding_staff_specialty"
        path: "PractitionerRole.code.coding.code"
        label: "Lead Core Clinical Specialty"
        description: "The primary specialized clinical category assigned to this staff member profile."
        uiComponent: "MultiSelect"
        choices: ["Cardiology", "Neurology", "Radiology", "Pediatrics", "Finance", "Triage"]
        required: true
